meta.title: TaoMenu — Lightweight QR ordering for small restaurants
meta.description: Customers scan a QR code to order. Owners run menus, staff terminals, and payment notes from a phone — no POS, no payment processing.

home.title: Lightweight QR ordering for restaurants, cafés, and banh mi shops
home.subtitle: Guests scan to browse the menu and order. Staff handle tickets on a phone. TaoMenu never takes meal payments and needs no POS hardware.
home.feature1Body: Customers scan a QR code, open the menu, and submit orders in the browser.
home.feature2Body: Owners register, build menus, and share table or pickup codes without a computer.
home.feature3Body: Support dine-in table codes and short pickup numbers for walk-up shops.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade to Pro when you need more terminals, languages, and AI tools.
pricing.freeDesc: Enough for a small shop to run day to day.
pricing.proDesc: For busy shops that need multi-language menus and faster setup.
pricing.proF3: Photo import / AI translate / voice assist

footer.tagline: QR ordering software for small restaurants in Vietnam.
